spans.s: लुमत् लु-मत्. See under 2. लुक्, p. 869.

लुम्ब् लुम्ब्, cl. 1. P. लुम्बति, &c., to
torment, harass; cl. 10. P. लुम्बयति,
&c., to torment; to be invisible.

लुम्बिका लुम्बिका, f. a particular musical
instrument.

लुम्बिनी लुम्बिनी, f., N. of a princess; of
a grove named after this princess.
लुम्बिनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to the above.

लूम लूम, अम्, n. (connected with लून,
q. v.), a tail, a hairy tail (as a horse's or monkey's).
—लूम-विष, अस्, m. ‘having poison in the tail,’
any animal that stings with the tail (as a scorpion).
